subject.title: cli-backend agent runs against anthropic (claude-cli runtime) return 401 authentication_failed while identical claude invocation works in shell

question: Should maintainers require a maintainer-run macOS LaunchAgent Claude CLI OAuth reproduction before changing OpenClaw's managed Claude CLI auth/runtime behavior for this 401 case?
rationale: The source path matches the report, but the failing condition depends on live Claude CLI OAuth, launchd service context, loopback MCP, and local credential/keychain state that this read-only review could not safely reproduce.

options.title: Require service-context proof
options.body: Run a maintainer-controlled macOS LaunchAgent repro comparing gateway cron/channel execution, same-service Claude CLI replay, live MCP config, empty MCP config, and redacted credential state before changing code.

options.title: Sponsor a targeted backend/auth fix now
options.body: Accept the reporter's wrapper trace as sufficient and change the Claude CLI backend or auth-selection path, with higher risk around service-context and env-isolation policy.

options.title: Scope this to recovery copy only
options.body: Treat this as covered by the expired-token re-auth-hint cluster only if live proof shows it is the same expired-token recovery failure rather than a distinct service-context or MCP failure.

recommendation.title: Require service-context proof
recommendation.body: Run a maintainer-controlled macOS LaunchAgent repro comparing gateway cron/channel execution, same-service Claude CLI replay, live MCP config, empty MCP config, and redacted credential state before changing code.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current owner signal is recent and current-main work around the Anthropic Claude CLI backend and live-session runtime path.
